description: This file declares exported API functions for the HTTP Authentication Client Object, including functions for creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It appears to be a header file defining interfaces rather than implementation.

methods.name: HttpCreateAuthco
methods.description: Creates an instance of the HTTP Authentication Client Object, taking container, owner, and reserved context handles as parameters.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoCreate
methods.description: Creates the HTTP Auth Client Object with specified context handles.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the HTTP Auth Client Object.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or dependencies for the HTTP Auth Client.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Auth Client Object.
